notes.title: itch.io Demo Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023431/387169fc93d1c3ec5c786b4076024f9573a42da3.png

We’re rolling out the first update to our Dawn of Defense demo on Itch.io! This update includes improvements such as visual and sound indicators for enemy invasions, reworked enemy paths, and tooltips for various game elements.

Check it out:
Dawn of Defense Demo

We've also revamped the start screen tutorial and made adjustments to the main menu and game visuals. Check the detailed changelog below for all the changes!

Changelog:

Add visual and sound indicators for enemy invasions
Rework enemy paths visualisation, add moving highlights, fix paths breaking up and not connecting to the player base
Add tooltips for the top menu bar, units, tavern and towers stats, demolish button
Rework and add videos to the start screen tutorial
Added visual feedback for whenever a player base is getting hit or when it gets destroyed
Change the main menu, game logo and game icon
Change enemy fortress description, specifically mention that capturing it will trigger a strong boss wave
Game ends after last boss wave
Fix units context menu not updating in real time
Fix building demolishing cost, now it scales based on the building initial cost
Fix bug where units would collide with already defeated units

notes.title: First Trailer!
notes.content:
Trailer 

Hey everyone!

We’ve got some exciting news – the very first trailer for Dawn of Defense is out on our Steam page!

[previewyoutube=pCXT2YVOyBA;full][/previewyoutube]

In these last few months we have been working hard on developing the game. We’ve made some huge progress, adding new cool towers and units, adding more gameplay systems, balancing and just overall working on our current game demo and making it better and more awesome.

And guess what? We’re not done yet! We’re hard at work on even more features and working on a full game demo that we eventually can also publish for everyone to try out.

A massive thank you to all of you for your interest and support. It means the world to us. If you want to stay updated on all things Dawn of Defense, join our Discord server. We’d love to see you there!
